# VAR-PLAN-0006: Host-wide regex scope

- Severity: warning
- Area: PLAN

## Description

use-regex or rewrite-target on one Ingress makes ingress-nginx match every path of that host as regex, including paths declared by other Ingresses.

## Remediation

Check every path of this host explicitly; the gateway implementation may match them literally.
